$comment: The registry of experience engines (contracts/experiences.md § The registry of experience engines). Closed: extended only by the specs, registryVersion raised at every change. Checked by scripts/check-experiences.mjs.

engines.name: presence
engines.what: The place experience: one photo or one clip taken at a point of interest (features/experiences/experience-feats.feature). Its own operations, its own format; declared here, never migrated.
creators: platform team

engines.name: route
engines.what: The route as an experience: following it is a run, finishing it an experience feat (features/experiences/route-experiences.feature). The route guidance and the route group sessions stay as they are. Evaluated on the device, not rankable (D-413, D-416 unchanged).
creators: the owner of the route
the leadership of the universe of a universe route

engines.name: challenge
engines.what: The simple challenge: a counter, a timer or nothing to measure, and a photo or a clip as proof (features/experiences/simple-challenges.feature).
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: challenge
engines.what: The simple challenge measured by the device (features/experiences/device-measures.feature, D-461): a count only, taken by a measuring means of the device (the steps of the health data, the voice count, the sound count, the camera count), on the device; only the count leaves it. Its experience proof is DEVICE_MEASURED, without a photo nor a clip nor a validation by people; a count entered or changed by hand is SELF_REPORTED. challenge/1 is unchanged beside it and keeps the simple challenges measured by hand.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: meetup
engines.what: The attendance meetup (features/experiences/attendance-meetups.feature, D-461): to be there, proven by the organizer code its experience organizer shows; group experience instances only, no measure, no failure, no ranking.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: multiday
engines.what: The multi-day challenge (features/experiences/multi-day-challenges.feature, D-467): a count with a target of the day, or nothing to measure, every challenge day for 1 to 30 challenge days, the calendar days of the experience instance in the time zone of its experience organizer at its start; a success when every challenge day is done, DEVICE_MEASURED when every one was measured by the device and sent as it was, SELF_REPORTED otherwise; no proof media, no validation by people, no ranking.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: rounds
engines.what: The multi-round challenge (features/experiences/multi-round-challenges.feature, D-467): 2 to 10 challenge rounds, each a count, a time or nothing to measure with its target, done in their order, all required, within endsWithinHours; DEVICE_MEASURED when every challenge round was measured by the device and sent as it was, SELF_REPORTED otherwise; no proof media, no validation by people, no ranking.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: tournament
engines.what: The simple tournament (features/experiences/simple-tournaments.feature, D-467): a single elimination of 4 to 32 tournament entrants drawn at random by the platform, the tournament byes to the first of the draw, each tournament match decided by the experience organizer, who is no tournament entrant; the winner of the last tournament match is a success PEOPLE_VALIDATED; a walkover for a tournament entrant who left.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: tournament
engines.what: The tournament (features/experiences/tournaments.feature, D-481, D-488, D-489): 2 to 64 tournament entrants in one of four formats (single elimination with an optional third-place match and consolation bracket, home and away, tournament pools then single elimination, score race with a threshold and lives), tournament matches of one game or a series (best of 3 or 5) on the match challenges of a discipline profile, ties to the tiebreak challenge then the experience organizer, and one validation level for the whole tournament (Trust, Witnesses with the mode Remote witnesses, Refereed), a result contest within 24 hours; the winner and the podium obtain their Feats. tournament/1 is unchanged beside it.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe and the accounts it allows to make tournaments
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: visit
engines.what: The visit experience: 1 to 30 visit stages (points of interest or free named points), in a free, suggested or strict order, done within 1 to 30 days with pauses, each checked within its radius on the device or self-reported, a photo or a clip when its creator requires it; done at its completion threshold (features/experiences/visit-experiences.feature, D-436). Evaluated on the device, not rankable, no time kept (as route/1). Slice 1: solo only.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe

engines.name: contest
engines.what: The judged contest (features/experiences/judged-contests.feature, D-488 (5), D-498): contest entries (a photo, a video, a text, an audio) submitted in 1 to 5 contest categories, one per person and contest category, up to 1,000 per edition, then judged by a contest jury (criteria grid, free ranking or deliberation), by a public vote of humans with a threshold of voters, or by both weighted; no tournament matches; the places 1 to 3 of each contest category and the Public's favorite obtain their Feats.
creators: an account
the leadership of a public universe
the platform team for the root universe
